lines: A ceiling lamp buzzes somewhere above the corridor.
The tube light flickers, stutters, then catches again.
The generator coughs twice and settles into a low rumble.
A fan blade ticks slower with every turn until it stops.
Static crackles from a radio left on the bench.
A relay clicks shut behind the wall panel.
Sparks spit from an exposed junction box in the corner.
Somewhere a fuse pops with a flat, dry snap.
The breaker thunks and the far wing goes dark.
Every light in the stairwell dims at once.
A low electric hum rises from the cable tray overhead.
The lamp over the door stutters on and off, on and off.
Water drips onto a warm transformer and hisses.
Radio static swells, then fades into nothing but white noise.
A tired fan drags against its housing, grinding softly.
The generator drone changes pitch, then steadies again.
Blue light strobes faintly under the crack of a door.
Dust drifts through a single beam of failing light.
The emergency lamp hums like a bee trapped in glass.
A relay chatter runs down the line, click by click.
Cables sway in a draft, brushing the wall with a soft sound.
The fluorescent tube ticks as it warms up, then flares.
A radio speaker crackles, then clears to a faint carrier tone.
The lights in the next room dim and brighten in slow pulses.
Something inside the wall sizzles and goes quiet.
A battery pack ticks as it cools down in the rack.
The generator sputters, catches, and runs rough for a while.
Overhead, a dead lamp swings on its chain, creaking.
A switch clacks in the dark, but nothing lights up.
Electric tang hangs in the air where a wire scorched.
The fan slows, groans, and stops with a final clunk.
Power surges through the panel with a sharp, sudden crack.
Each time the relay clicks, the hallway lamps flicker.
A coil whines somewhere deep in the building's guts.
The radio hisses between stations like rain on tin.
Blackout hits, and silence falls heavy and total for a moment.
The lights come back in a stuttering, uneven wave.
A cable arcs against the railing with a bright blue pop.
The lamp bulb pops and a little smoke curls up.
Quiet, then the generator thumps back to life below.
A faint buzz follows the wiring along the ceiling.
Static scratches over a voice that is not quite there.
The panel flickers red, then goes dark again.
Relay hum builds in the walls, then cuts off abruptly.
Lamps drone on at half power, too dim to read by.
Sparks rain down from a frayed line near the ladder.
The fan spins up again, rattling against its guard.
Electricity crawls along the pipe with a sour buzz.
A tube light sputters, goes dark, and does not return.
The circuit board in the booth smells faintly of burnt plastic.
Somewhere a generator starts up, far off and very loud.
Fuse wire glows orange in the dim box by the door.
The power hum drops away, leaving the room too quiet.
Radio static peaks, then sweeps down into a flat whine.
A charged cable snaps loose and whips across the floor.
A fluorescent ballast chatters like teeth in the cold.
The lamps buzz in time with a slow, uneven pulse.
Burnt air drifts from a vent grate above the stairs.
The lights flicker twice, as if counting something unseen.
A relay somewhere opens and closes, opens and closes.
The generator groans under load and the lights sag.
Hot metal ticks in the dark as the bulb cools.
A dead fan hangs from one bolt, turning in the draft.
Static spikes on the radio, then drops out completely.
The wall panel hums, warm to the touch, almost alive.
Light from a broken fixture spills across the wet floor.
A transformer buzzes louder as the room grows colder.
The breaker box rattles on its mounts, then falls still.
Something crackles along the wire, then goes silent again.
The tube lights blink out in a slow, rolling wave.
Power returns with a loud clunk and a humming sigh.
A lamp shade rattles above, shaking loose a little dust.
The radio coughs out a few words, then is lost again.
Current hums through the grate, faint and steady as breathing.
A panel lights up, flashes a warning, then dies.
